headline: Motilal Oswal's Amit Gupta picks Jamna Auto, Karur Vysya Bank, and One97 Communications
hook: Four years of flat returns at Jamna Auto
summary: Motilal Oswal Private Wealth Director Amit Gupta has identified investment opportunities in the current market correction. His picks include auto ancillary firm Jamna Auto, Karur Vysya Bank, Paytm parent One97 Communications, and the domestic pharma sector. Gupta favors Jamna Auto despite its four-year stagnation. Indian retail investors tracking expert stock selections can review these names for portfolio alignment.
why_it_matters: Expert highlights overlooked stocks for portfolio consideration during market correction.

headline: Jamna Auto Industries submits an update on ongoing litigation to the exchange
hook: Routine litigation update from auto components maker
summary: Jamna Auto Industries Limited has submitted a formal update regarding ongoing litigation to the stock exchanges. The company made this regulatory disclosure as part of standard compliance procedures. No financial impact or operational disruption has been detailed in the filing yet. Retail investors should note that routine litigation updates rarely move stock prices unless a major penalty or adverse judgment is involved.
why_it_matters: No immediate financial impact on your holdings expected.
